## Topics

- Random number generation and reproducibility (set.seed())
- Probability distributions in R: r/d/p/q functions (norm, binom, pois, exp)
- Random sampling and permutation with sample()
- Monte Carlo simulation of public health epidemics
- Empirical demonstrations of the Central Limit Theorem (CLT)
- Final project announcement: see the [Project page](../project.qmd)
